{{Top|leg}}
The '''Advanced Stealth unit''' was an advanced [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generator]] that refined the stealth field in order to better hide the wearer of this belt. Similarly to other stealth units, combat would disrupt the field, while ordinary tasks would not.
